content.text:
The bug was in `to_cents` in `ledger/currency.py`. It used `int(amount * 100)`, which truncates. Float error turns 19.99 into 1998.999…, so it came out as 1998. I changed it to `round(amount * 100)`. All 5 tests pass, including `tests/test_report.py`.

`round` is correct for any amount with at most two decimal places, which is what the rest of the code assumes. If amounts can arrive with more decimals, they would need an explicit rounding rule. I didn't change that.
